name: cover_reclaim
about: Claim -> release -> re-claim (spec 0002 V1 'Cover', the 2026-09-30 run 6 as a record). The cover record's opening (SCHED_TROIKA_TAKE_COVER_HINT 0x9b, a corner hint claimed through 0x102b7110 / reserve 0x102d1350), then both corner hints are destroyed by their retail Kill input. The hint's destructor 0x102d3040 resolves its owner (hint +0x5e0 -> entity +0x98), SetCondition(COND_HINT_INVALID 0x29) and ClearHintNode(0.0) (0x10295ab0: the claim released, AT_COVER_HINT cleared). COND_HINT_INVALID is in the running cover program's interrupt list (sched_troika_take_cover_hint_vs_melee*.sch / _attack.sch), so the program breaks; the next combat selection runs the cover chooser 0x102b7690 again (no m_pHintNode) and its search 0x102b7110 claims the next valid cover hint after the cursor: cover_low_north, whose facing (0.950) and projection gates are authored for the cover seat (docs/harness/green-room-arena.md section 1). Then 0x9b again on the new hint. (The +5.0 path-failure release, TaskFail's ClearHintNode(5.0), needs a cover hint the mesh cannot reach: no arena node is one; a harness gap.)
